_comment: Manifest of the plugin unit. It must match the descriptor of the adapter (TCK case 6). The host reads it without running code of the unit: when the jar is uploaded, before loading (apiMinor), when it registers the adapter against its descriptor, and to show the unit before its release. The mapping template is always META-INF/rmm-adapter/mapping-template.json; the manifest names no path for it.
name: CSV Example Tool
